job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant

items.text:
Title: Hotel booking for Finance offsite
Time: 2025-06-12 09:00–10:00
Description: Admin team will walk through the hotel contract and cancellation policy for the Lisbon offsite. Do not reply to this invite; send questions to the events alias.

Title: Data migration dry-run review
Time: 2025-06-12 14:00–15:00
Description: Review the vendor's migration checklist and confirm the rollback steps. The automated tool flagged two tables—please bring the export logs.

Title: Hackathon budget sign-off
Time: 2025-06-13 11:30–12:00
Description: Confidential pre-read attached; finance admin needs your approval on catering and prizes. Do not reply all.

Title: Hotel room block reconciliation
Time: 2025-06-16 10:00–10:45
Description: We need to reconcile the room block for the July leadership retreat against the final attendee list. Prior to the call, please check the hotel's confirmation email and note any no-show charges. The finance admin will share a short instructions sheet for coding the charges to the right cost centre. If anything looks confidential, mark it and we'll handle it offline. Do not reply to the calendar invite; add comments in the shared sheet instead. The hotel's chatbot quoted a different rate, so we'll compare that too.

Title: Migration cutover go/no-go
Time: 2025-06-17 16:00–17:00
Description: Final check before the finance data migration; admin will circulate the runbook. Do not reply—RSVP in the tracker.

Title: Hackathon logistics and reimbursements
Time: 2025-06-18 13:00–14:00
Description: This session covers travel reimbursement for the internal hackathon, including receipts and per-diem rules. The finance admin will demo the new automated tool for expense submission. Please review the instructions in the portal before the meeting so we can answer questions quickly. Confidential attendee data will be handled separately and should not be shared in the main channel. Do not reply to this invite; sign up in the HR helpdesk queue.

Title: Post-migration payroll checks
Time: 2025-06-19 09:30–10:15
Description: After the data migration, payroll admin will verify that bank details and tax codes carried over correctly. We'll use the reconciliation report and the vendor's automated checker. If you spot a discrepancy, log it in the confidential issues tracker rather than emailing details. Instructions for the tracker are in the HR helpdesk article. Do not reply to this invite; the tracker is the source of truth.

Title: Hackathon judging and prize budget
Time: 2025-06-20 15:00–16:00
Description: Judges will align on scoring before the hackathon demos, and finance will confirm the prize budget. The admin team has prepared a short instructions doc for submitting scores through the internal chatbot. Please keep judging deliberations confidential until winners are announced. Do not reply to this invite; use the judging portal to confirm attendance.

Title: Hotel invoice query
Time: 2025-06-23 11:00–11:30
Description: Quick call with the hotel's billing admin about the duplicate invoice; finance will bring the payment run instructions. Do not reply.

Title: Data migration lessons learned
Time: 2025-06-24 14:00–15:00
Description: We'll capture what worked and what didn't in the finance data migration, including how the automated validation tool performed. Admin will share a template for your notes ahead of time, and instructions for submitting them to the HR helpdesk. Some examples may involve confidential vendor terms, so please anonymise them. Do not reply to this invite; add your notes to the shared folder. If you can't attend, send a delegate.
